title: President's Message
content: President's Message Melissa Crisp, PhD, became President of the SLAS Board of Directors on January 1, 2026. She is Senior Director of Screening and Automation, Biotechnology Discovery Research at Eli Lilly in San Diego, CA, USA, and she’ll be sharing her conversations with a variety of SLAS members throughout the year.
